'''John John's Death Star Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[John]]
* '''Published:''' 31 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Docking Bay 327|Premiere-D-deathstardockingbay327.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star: Docking Bay 327
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 Death Star Docking Bay 327 John DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

My deck is built up of death star sites and bounty hunters.

The published list has 56 cards.

== Strategy ==

Hopefully I can blow up the opponents rebel base so they are forced to come into my Death star. Then I can kill them off with my bounty hunters. If there are any rebels left in starships then they will have to deploy in my death star and I can kill them off.
